*"Your policy includes endorsement HW-7, which covers mold abatement when performed by a licensed mold-remediation vendor within 30 days of the loss and confirmed as resulting from a covered water event. They have a right to know what they purchased, and I couldn't let the window expire without answering them honestly. Standard practice or not, that would be concealment. I understand your concern about the quarter's metrics, but I'm not willing to withhold coverage information a claimant is entitled to and has directly requested.
